paragraphs: Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya: [Gittin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.45b.6).
Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya: [Pesachim 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.76a.13-14).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Gittin names Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya as the reciter of a baraita.
Pesachim names Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya in a separate case. The passage gives the full title Rav where Hyman has the abbreviation ר׳.
